reasoning: On the season so far the Spurs are the stronger team; with home court the Spurs start about 17 points better, in a game of about 233 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Spurs.
The mental side leans about 0 points towards the Spurs.
Bottom line: the Spurs win 96 times in 100, by about 20; most games like this end between 207 and 256 total points.
